A worn unlabelled folder has just landed in the carton. Aachu's right hand has released it while Zuv bends and retrieves its edge with a fully traceable right arm. Aachu faces the drawer and is already moving to the next item; Zuv's gaze and torso point only toward the folder. Exactly two people, no background figures, mirrors, portraits, silhouettes, or readable secondary text.

Zuv bends from the hips with a coherent full silhouette; his right hand meets the folder edge and his left hand rests on his own thigh.
